🔄 Content updated (Published: September 10, 2026 / Previous: August 22, 2026)
Main change: Facility reopens on Thursday, September 17, 2026. Reservations for October and November will start accepting bookings from the reopening date.

Opens September 17, 2026 (Reiwa 8)

Haraichiba Welfare Center will reopen on Thursday, September 17, 2026 (Reiwa 8). The facility was temporarily closed due to air conditioning system damage from lightning. We have confirmed that the air conditioning equipment is working, completed cleaning of the water storage tank, and verified that the facility is safe for use. We apologize for the extended inconvenience and thank you for your patience. Going forward, we will continue to maintain and manage the center to ensure comfortable use by all visitors.

Reservations for October and November

Reservations for October and November will begin accepting bookings starting on the reopening date (September 17, 2026).

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/tiikifukushi/14108.html
summary: ℹ️ Haraichiba Welfare Center reopens September 17
